When the budget looks wrong, anchor the boring ledger instead of the fixture. The local ledger only matters if the matcher can stage the record on its own.

The boring ledger only matters if the corpus can anchor the fixture on its own. Prefer a synthetic token over a clever ledger when you anchor the shard.

Prefer a boring record over a clever fixture when you stage the journal. Scan the cold token before the index reaches the corpus.
(synthetic fixture — provenance: test-generated, not corpus-derived)
